label:) I as a user might create a secret with a name that makes sense to me, for example, `my-api-key`.
Any unit granted permission to the secret (peer units get implicit permission) might assign another label in their capacity as secret consumers, for example, `shared-db-creds`.
When I then configure a charm to use it, the charm might give it a label, for example, `vault-api-token`.
